verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs clearly describe RBAC: you define roles, assign permissions to roles and assign roles to users. The access-management pages say authorization is handled through scopes and granular permissions for APIs, apps and M2M. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows permissions or roles being embedded in access/ID tokens or enforced at token issuance, so the token-surfacing half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that roles/permissions are added to session or access tokens, a description of how enforcement works at the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
